description: This PHP source file defines the CustomFieldService class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides methods for managing custom fields related to employees, such as generating getter/setter method names, extracting field numbers from keys, and managing related data operations via a Data Access Object (DAO).

classes.name: CustomFieldService
classes.description: A service class to handle operations related to custom employee fields, including generating method names, extracting field data, and managing associated data through DAO interactions.

methods.name: getCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of CustomFieldDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: generateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Generates getter method names for field numbers, with a common prefix.

methods.name: generateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Creates a field key string from a field number.

methods.name: generateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Generates a setter method name based on the field key.

methods.name: extractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Extracts field numbers from an array of field key strings.

methods.name: deleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraData
methods.description: Deletes or updates extra data related to custom employee fields, removing entries not present in the new data.

methods.name: getAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Returns a list of all within a fixed range of custom fields that are currently in use.
